patronOf.pt-BR: A veste branca de todos os que servem

prayerExcerpt.en-US: These who are clothed in white robes are they who survived the time of great distress and have washed their robes in the blood of the Lamb, alleluia.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Estes, vestidos com túnicas brancas, são os que vieram da grande tribulação e lavaram suas vestes no sangue do Cordeiro, aleluia.

meta.basis: 'The sacred garment common to all ordained and instituted ministers of any rank is the alb, to be tied at the waist with a cincture' (GIRM 336); it is prepared in the sacristy for priest, deacon and other ministers (GIRM 119). White is its name and its traditional colour, a linen tunic to the feet with close sleeves, lace permitted as ornament (Catholic Encyclopedia, 'Alb'); the GIRM leaves the materials to the Conferences (GIRM 343) and wants beauty 'in the material used and in the design' (GIRM 344). The lace border is a traditional choice. The excerpt's Latin is 'amicti sunt stolis albis', clothed in white robes.
